description: This is a PHP unit test class for the MyClaimRequestAPI endpoint in the OrangeHRM Claim module. It tests API functionalities like create, getOne, and getAll for claim requests.

classes.name: MyClaimRequestAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the MyClaimRequestAPI endpoints related to claim requests in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.description: Provides test data for the create claim request test.
